final: WITH filtered_trans AS (SELECT account_id, amount, balance, type FROM trans WHERE amount > 2400), signed_data AS (SELECT account_id, CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END as signed_amount, balance FROM filtered_trans), account_averages AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(signed_amount) as avg_signed_amount, AVG(balance) as avg_balance FROM signed_data GROUP BY account_id HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN signed_amount IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) > 0) SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) as overall_avg_signed, AVG(avg_balance) as overall_avg_balance FROM account_averages
